description: This file contains Less code defining styles for Bootstrap dropdown components, including dropdown menu positioning, hover states, disabled states, and UI tweaks.

classes.name: .caret
classes.description: Styles for the dropdown arrow/caret indicator.

classes.name: .dropdown-toggle:focus
classes.description: Removes outline when focusing on dropdown toggle to prevent focus outline.

classes.name: .dropdown-menu
classes.description: Main dropdown menu styles, including positioning, appearance, and states.

classes.name: .dropdown-menu-right
classes.description: Aligns dropdown menu to the right.

classes.name: .dropdown-menu-left
classes.description: Aligns dropdown menu to the left.

classes.name: .dropdown-header
classes.description: Styles for section headers within dropdown menus.

classes.name: .dropdown-backdrop
classes.description: Backdrop overlay for catching body clicks on mobile.

classes.name: .dropup
classes.description: Styles for bottom-up dropdowns and caret reversal.
